defects.problem: Ordinary Markdown source Worker eagerly included KaTeX via both model and texmath fallback.
defects.fix: Engine-free compatible matcher, lazy per-editor native math Worker, separate synchronous Notebook-only adapter.

boundaries: A actual packaged App and native file service, real KaTeX module/Worker/errors/results and real UI input. Test-only Chromium debugger-start pauses real Worker module initialization without changing bytes; original webRequest/protocol handlers unchanged. Explicit missing-module constructor URL faults produce real trusted Worker errors, not synthetic errors. Native ErrorEvent gates prevent default solely to avoid gate-induced unhandled reporting, then forward the original unchanged core event. Passive Worker/file RPC/requestMeasure observation. No fake engine results, editor/Store/DOM value injection, clipboard, daily files, models, external apps or Codex. X07 fine-grained formula selection remains unaccepted.

P only: synthetic standalone shared FileMarkdown/Notebook React StrictMode harness, real browser and original KaTeX Worker. No actual file service, native App business, physical IME or full Codex visual claim.

U-only controlled transports/timers separately labelled; I real native broker/file service/current compiled two Workers/actual EditorView, not packaged renderer UI. Native dependencies reused r64 are byte-identical to r65.

Final original module initialization pauses are Chromium debugger-start handshakes, not protocol/Fetch interceptions; cancelled Workers never claimed to render after termination. Success/error late delivery uses separately captured actual native events. Explicit missing resource URL faults alter only selected constructor URL, not fabricated output.

3 actual native errors, one nongated and two gated with disclosed synchronous preventDefault; original core type/error fields and real native message data unchanged. Existing security/webRequest and protocol untouched.
P synthetic harness uses real engine but not native file business, full Codex pixel/IME proof or other platform. X03/X07/X12, manual/system/reference and whole419 remain pending. No release.
